artifact_schema.description: The discrete logarithm k, encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

k.description: The representative k in [1, n) satisfying [k]P = Q on Certicom ECC2-131.

statement: Solve Certicom's published ECC2-131 elliptic-curve discrete logarithm challenge: find k in [1, n) such that [k]P = Q on y^2 + xy = x^3 + a*x^2 + b over GF(2^131), with field polynomial x^131 + x^13 + x^2 + x + 1. The curve coefficients, subgroup order, generator P, and target Q are the fixed values published in Certicom's curve list and pinned by the checker. Return k as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. This objective pays Cairn's notional reward only; it does not include a Certicom prize.
